$comment: Project-wide permission allowlist. Written 2026-08-11 from the commands this
project's sessions actually run, to cut repeated approval prompts.
DELIBERATELY NOT ALLOWLISTED, and they should stay that way:
reset_branch / pause_project / restore_project — these write to the LIVE
database a real beta is playing on. Two agents were flagged in one session
for applying schema changes on a Coordinator's say-so rather than Tyler's.
Each of those should stay a deliberate, named act.
· rm / del / Remove-Item, git reset --hard, git push --force — destructive.
· curl / Invoke-WebRequest — an open egress hole; ask per use.
execute_sql IS allowlisted and is a judgement call: it can write. It is here
because proving an exploit open before closing it is the core working method on
this project, and that is done with read-only queries and single-call
`begin … rollback` probes. A chunked `begin` does NOT hold across calls and would
commit its DDL — never split one.
